SECOND_DISTINCT_DEFECT_the_one_that_hide.why_it_matters_more_than_it_looks: This is the mechanism by which the naming defect stays invisible. 'No snapshot in this range' reads to any human or auditor as 'the writer did not run'. The writer ran fine every time. A reader that said 'I looked for cycle-snapshot-05:05.json and it was not there' would have exposed the whole defect on its first occurrence.
SECOND_DISTINCT_DEFECT_the_one_that_hide.remedy: Have the reader report the LITERAL key it computed, not a range gloss. Cheap, and it is the difference between a self-reporting defect and a silent one.
